headword: {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}

definitions.explanation: The combined demographic trend of fewer children being born and a growing share of elderly people. A standard term in Japanese news and policy discussion.

examples.japanese: {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The birthrate keeps falling and the population keeps aging.

examples.japanese: {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: The falling birthrate and aging population are a major challenge for Japan.

examples.japanese: {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{統合|とうごう}→統合：09615_tougou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相次|あいつ}いでいる→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧。
examples.english: Because of the falling birthrate and aging population, school mergers keep happening in rural areas.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧ (falling birthrate) and ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧ (population aging). Almost always appears with ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ or in the phrase {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: the trend advances
- {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: a society with few children and many elderly
- {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against the trend
- {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧: accompanying the trend (labor shortages, pension costs)

REGISTER:
Formal, the vocabulary of news, white papers and essays; in conversation people more often say {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧.
